280542613.description:
Aurabloom VIP Crystal Club Collection - 42 Pieces
Natural Stone Towers, Pyramids, Skulls, and Accessories
Multi-Color Mineral Specimen Lot
Comprehensive 42-piece collection of decorative crystals featuring a wide variety of natural stone specimens in popular geometric cuts. This assembly includes an assortment of towers, obelisks, and pyramids, ranging from miniature points to large statement pieces. Sourced from the Aurabloom VIP Crystal Club, these pieces showcase a diverse spectrum of mineral types including amethyst, rose quartz, lapis lazuli, tiger's eye, and fluorite, perfect for collection, display, or crystal healing practices.
Pieces Included:
Large Black Obelisk - Approximately 6 inches tall with unique circular indentation
Assorted Crystal Towers - Approximately 20 pieces including rose quartz, tiger's eye, rainbow fluorite, lapis lazuli, and moonstone
Crystal Pyramids - 4 pieces including large black, small clear quartz, and green aventurine style specimens
Carved Crystal Skulls - 1 opalite style and 1 miniature black skull carving
Specialized Specimens - 1 iridescent aura quartz cluster, 1 orange double-terminated point with gold moon/star decals, and various rough stones
Jewelry & Tools - 7-stone chakra hanging ornament, amethyst point pendant, and a crystal water bottle insert wand filled with amethyst chips
Branded Accessories - 2 red satin Aurabloom pouches, 2 white fabric pouches, and collector insert card
Condition:
The collection is in excellent overall condition. Polished towers, obelisks, and pyramids maintain crisp points and smooth facets with no significant structural damage or large chips. Natural rough specimens retain their original organic texture. All fabric pouches are clean and the chakra hanging remains fully intact. Total lot weight is 8.6 pounds.
